record.description: Proposed integrated program combining measurements across distinct historical/stratigraphic layers with route-dependent transport. Components exist at varying maturity; complete integrated empirical assay remains unverified.
record.note: The functional combines observation residuals with a loop-transport discrepancy. It requires a defined state space, a connection or typed transport law, a common base fibre, an observed loop target and a compatible metric. The two terms may share data and therefore need dependence accounting. A penalty does not establish that loop targets were independently measured.
